# Theme brief: Experience tab and its pages

Used by `/experience/` and `/experience/*/`. Tokens: `/experience/project-theme.css` (pages) and `/experience/style.css` (tab).
A blueprint of a network: navy drafting paper `#0B2545` with a fine grid and a heavier line every fifth square, white
and cyan linework `#9CC9FF` / `#8FD8FF`, amber packets `#FFC857`. Barlow Condensed (uppercase display) and Barlow.
Each job is a drawing sheet with corner ticks and a title block. The tab scene (`experience/scene.js`) is a plain 2D
canvas: routers and dashed links with amber packets moving between them.
Verizon pages: show the carrier-network work as topology diagrams with packet flows. Do not use Verizon's logo
(no permission). The cables photo is stock and credited.
